activities.prompt: Which instruction is less ambiguous for a robot?
activities.explanation: A specific direction and distance make the step clear.

activities.prompt: A loop repeats “move right” four times. How many squares does the robot move?
activities.explanation: Four repetitions produce four moves.

activities.prompt: An outer loop repeats twice; each time an inner loop claps three times. How many claps?
activities.explanation: Two groups of three claps make six.

activities.prompt: A counter starts at 0 and increases by 1 in a loop that runs 4 times. What is its value?
activities.explanation: The counter progresses 0, 1, 2, 3, 4.

/grades/grade-6/life-skills/practice/sel.title: Self-image & Changes
/grades/grade-6/life-skills/practice/sel.description: Respect body changes, build confidence and seek support.

activities.prompt: Two classmates grow at different rates. What is a respectful response?
activities.explanation: People grow and change at different times; respect their privacy.

activities.prompt: A picture online suggests everyone should look the same. What should you remember?
activities.helper: Pictures can be edited and do not define worth.
options: Bodies differ and images may be edited
The picture sets a rule for everyone
activities.answer: Bodies differ and images may be edited
activities.explanation: Media images may be edited, and people naturally look different.

activities.prompt: Which statement supports healthy self-esteem?
options: I can practise and learn a new skill
I must be perfect at once
activities.answer: I can practise and learn a new skill
activities.explanation: A skill can improve with practice and support.

activities.prompt: A classmate asks an embarrassing question about your body. What can you do?
activities.helper: You may set a boundary and ask for help.
options: Say you do not want to answer and speak to a trusted adult
Share private details to stop them asking
activities.answer: Say you do not want to answer and speak to a trusted adult
activities.explanation: You can keep personal information private and seek support.

activities.prompt: Which goal is small enough to practise and check?
options: Read ten minutes on school days
activities.answer: Read ten minutes on school days
activities.explanation: A specific, manageable goal is easier to practise.

/grades/grade-6/mathematics/practice/who.title: Whole Numbers & Operations
/grades/grade-6/mathematics/practice/who.description: Use place value, factors and the four operations.

activities.prompt: What is the value of 6 in 2 645 091?
activities.explanation: The 6 is in the hundred-thousands place.

activities.prompt: Round 476 381 to the nearest ten thousand.
activities.explanation: Six thousands means the ten-thousands digit rounds up.

activities.prompt: Calculate 36 × 24.
Calculate 936 ÷ 12.
Which number is a multiple of both 6 and 9?
activities.helper: Check whether both divide the number exactly.

/grades/grade-6/science/practice/photosy.title: Photosynthesis & Nutrition
/grades/grade-6/science/practice/photosy.description: Explore how plants make food and how people eat a varied diet.

activities.prompt: What energy source helps green plants make food?
activities.explanation: Green plants use light energy in photosynthesis.

activities.prompt: Which gas do plants take in during photosynthesis?
activities.helper: Think of carbon dioxide in the air.
activities.explanation: Plants take in carbon dioxide to make food during photosynthesis.

activities.prompt: Which gas is released by plants during photosynthesis?
activities.helper: The gas is useful to many animals.
activities.explanation: Photosynthesis releases oxygen.

activities.prompt: Which nutrient group helps the body grow and repair tissues?
activities.helper: Beans and eggs can supply it.
activities.explanation: Proteins help build and repair body tissues.

activities.prompt: Which meal includes a variety of food groups?
activities.helper: Look for different kinds of foods.
activities.explanation: A varied meal can supply carbohydrates, proteins and vitamins and minerals.

/grades/grade-6/social-sciences/practice.title: World Maps & Trade
/grades/grade-6/social-sciences/practice.description: Use world maps, direction, scale and trade clues.

activities.prompt: Which imaginary line divides Earth into northern and southern halves?
activities.helper: It crosses the middle of the globe.
activities.explanation: The equator divides Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

activities.prompt: Which hemisphere contains South Africa?
activities.helper: South Africa lies below the equator.
activities.explanation: South Africa lies south of the equator.

activities.prompt: A map scale says 1 cm represents 10 km. How far does 3 cm represent?
activities.explanation: Three map centimetres represent three lots of 10 km.

activities.prompt: A country buys goods produced in another country. What are these goods called?
activities.helper: The goods come into the country.
activities.explanation: Imports are goods bought from another country.

activities.prompt: A country sells locally produced fruit to another country. What is the fruit to the seller?
activities.explanation: Exports are goods sold to another country.

/grades/grade-6/words/practice/reading-a.title: Reading & Inference
/grades/grade-6/words/practice/reading-a.description: Use evidence, identify purpose and draw careful conclusions.

activities.prompt: Which detail suggests the school garden needed water?
activities.helper: Find a clue in the passage.
activities.audioText: By midday, the soil felt dry and the bean leaves were drooping. Amina filled a watering can and watered the beds. The next morning, the leaves stood upright.
options: The soil felt dry and leaves drooped
activities.answer: The soil felt dry and leaves drooped
activities.explanation: Both details are evidence that the plants needed water.

activities.prompt: Why did Amina water the plants?
activities.helper: Use what happened before she fetched the can.
activities.audioText: By midday, the soil felt dry and the bean leaves were drooping. Amina filled a watering can and watered the beds. The next morning, the leaves stood upright.
options: She noticed signs the plants needed water
She wanted to wash the leaves
She was told to move the beds
activities.answer: She noticed signs the plants needed water
activities.explanation: The dry soil and drooping leaves led her to water them.

activities.prompt: What is the purpose of this notice?
activities.helper: Decide what the reader should do.
activities.audioText: Library notice: Please return borrowed books by Friday so that other learners can use them next week.
activities.explanation: The notice asks learners to return borrowed books by Friday.

activities.prompt: What is the main idea?
activities.helper: Find the idea that connects the actions.
activities.audioText: Families met by the river. Some collected litter, others sorted recyclable bottles, and a small group planted indigenous trees. Together they made the riverbank cleaner.
options: Families worked together to care for the riverbank
A family bought a new boat
activities.answer: Families worked together to care for the riverbank
activities.explanation: Each action helped improve the riverbank.

activities.prompt: What happened before the trees were planted?
activities.helper: Follow the order in the passage.
activities.audioText: First, the group collected litter. They sorted bottles into recycling bags. Finally, they planted two trees near the path.
activities.explanation: Bottle sorting comes before planting in the passage.

/grades/grade-3/coding/practice/patterns.title: Patterns & Rules
/grades/grade-3/coding/practice/patterns.description: Read repeated rules and spot errors.

activities.prompt: What comes next?
activities.explanation: The group starts with red again.

activities.prompt: What number follows this rule?
activities.explanation: 12 plus 3 is 15.

activities.prompt: Which number breaks the add-four rule?
activities.explanation: 16 belongs between 12 and 20.

activities.prompt: What comes after the square?
activities.helper: Find the first shape in the group.
activities.explanation: The three-shape pattern starts again with a star.

activities.prompt: Which rule describes this pattern?
activities.helper: Count each colour in one group.
activities.explanation: Two green circles are followed by one yellow circle.

/grades/grade-3/life-skills/practice/liv.title: Living Things
/grades/grade-3/life-skills/practice/liv.description: Observe plants, animals and their needs.

activities.prompt: What does a young plant need to grow?
activities.helper: Think about caring for a seedling.
activities.explanation: Plants need water and light to grow.

activities.prompt: Which part of a plant takes in water from soil?
activities.explanation: Roots take in water from soil.

activities.prompt: Why does an animal need shelter?
activities.explanation: Shelter helps protect animals.

activities.prompt: How can you observe an insect safely?
activities.helper: Let it stay in its home.
activities.explanation: Observing without harming the insect is respectful.

activities.prompt: What might grow from a bean seed?
activities.explanation: A bean seed can grow into a bean plant.

activities.prompt: Two hundreds, three tens and six ones make?
activities.helper: Put the hundreds, tens and ones together.

activities.prompt: What is the value of the 7 in 470?
activities.helper: The 7 is in the tens place.
activities.explanation: The 7 stands for seven tens, or 70.

activities.prompt: Which number is five hundreds and eight ones?
Which number is greater?
activities.explanation: Both have three hundreds; 341 has more tens.

activities.prompt: How many hundreds make 900?
activities.explanation: Nine hundreds make 900.

/grades/grade-3/words/practice/sounds-an.title: Sounds & Spelling
/grades/grade-3/words/practice/sounds-an.description: Notice letter patterns in familiar words.

activities.prompt: Which word has the same vowel sound as rain?
activities.helper: Say rain and the options aloud.
activities.explanation: Rain and train share the ai sound.

activities.prompt: Which word has the same igh spelling as light?
activities.explanation: Light and night both have igh.

activities.prompt: Which word has the same oa spelling as boat?
activities.explanation: Boat and coat both contain oa.

activities.prompt: Which word begins with the same sound as shop?
activities.explanation: Shop and shell start with sh.

activities.prompt: Which word begins with the same blend as tree?
activities.explanation: Tree and train start with tr.

/grades/grade-2/coding/practice/patterns.title: Patterns & Debugging
/grades/grade-2/coding/practice/patterns.description: Find rules and fix a wrong step.

activities.prompt: Which shape comes next?
activities.explanation: Red, blue, yellow repeats.

activities.prompt: Which picture breaks the pattern?
activities.helper: Look for two colours taking turns.
activities.explanation: The last picture should be green.

activities.prompt: What comes after the star?
activities.explanation: The four-shape group starts again with a triangle.

activities.prompt: Which number does not follow the rule?
activities.explanation: Counting in twos gives 2, 4, 6, 8, 10.

activities.prompt: What is the rule?
activities.explanation: The group is one apple followed by two bananas.

activities.prompt: Which drink does your body need?
activities.helper: Think of a drink you need every day.
activities.explanation: Our bodies need safe drinking water.

activities.prompt: What do we breathe?
activities.explanation: We breathe air.

activities.prompt: Which picture shows food?
activities.explanation: An apple is food.

activities.prompt: What can help protect you from strong sun?
activities.explanation: A hat and shade can help protect you in strong sun.

activities.prompt: You do not know whether water is safe to drink. What should you do?
activities.explanation: A trusted adult can help you find safe drinking water.

/grades/grade-2/mathematics/practice/ten.title: Tens & Ones
/grades/grade-2/mathematics/practice/ten.description: Build two-digit numbers from tens and ones.

activities.prompt: One ten and four ones make which number?
activities.helper: Start at ten, then count four more.

activities.prompt: How many tens and ones are in 23?
activities.helper: Read each digit by its place.
activities.explanation: 23 is 20 plus 3.

activities.prompt: Which number is three tens?
activities.explanation: Three tens make 30.

activities.prompt: What is the value of the 4 in 47?
activities.helper: The 4 is in the tens place.
activities.explanation: The 4 represents four tens, or 40.

activities.prompt: Five tens and two ones make which number?
activities.helper: Count the tens, then the ones.

/grades/grade-2/words/practice/sounds-an.title: Sounds & Blends
/grades/grade-2/words/practice/sounds-an.description: Listen for beginning and ending sounds.

activities.prompt: Which word begins with sh?
activities.explanation: Shell starts with sh.

activities.prompt: Which word begins with ch?
activities.explanation: Chair starts with ch.

activities.prompt: Which word begins with th?
activities.explanation: Thumb starts with th.

activities.prompt: Which word begins with st?
activities.explanation: Star starts with st.

activities.prompt: Which word ends with ng?
activities.explanation: Sing ends with ng.
